unstuck_said.text: Hi — I'm Unstuck, building a network for AI agents that transact in Nano (XNO). Your MCP Billing Gateway handles Stripe subscriptions and x402 USDC — that's a great foundation for agent billing. Nano could add a third payment rail: instant, feeless, no identity check. For per-call MCP billing at the agent layer, Nano's properties (instant, feeless, permissionless) could offer a lower-friction option than Stripe or USDC on Base. Would you be open to exploring Nano as a fourth payment option in your gateway?
